observations: Photo 0 shows a red-framed portable generator with a black engine housing.
The brand 'FIRMAN' is clearly visible in white letters on the front panel.
The model 'ECO 8990ESR' is printed next to the brand name on the front panel.
The generator has a red handle on top and two wheels at the back.
A label on the front indicates '6700 Starting watts' and '6100 Running watts'.
The words 'ZERO TECHNOLOGY' are printed in red below the model number.
The engine and exhaust components are visible through the frame.
No visible damage or wear is apparent in the photo.

claims.claim: The Sumec Firman ECO8990ESR 7.0 kVA generator is a robust and efficient petrol-powered generator
claims.evidence: Photo 0 shows the FIRMAN ECO 8990ESR model with a petrol engine, matching the description. The 7.0 kVA rating is approximately equivalent to 6700 starting watts (as shown on the label), supporting the claim.

risks.risk: The generator may not be in working condition or may have hidden mechanical issues.
risks.proof: A video or photo showing the generator starting and running smoothly, with no smoke or unusual noise.

risks.risk: The generator may have been used extensively or has hidden wear not visible in the photo.
risks.proof: Photos of the engine internals, fuel tank, and exhaust system from multiple angles, including under the frame.

risks.risk: The generator may not be genuine or may be a counterfeit model.
risks.proof: A close-up photo of the serial number plate and a receipt or proof of purchase from an authorized dealer.

proof_requests: Video of the generator starting and running for 30 seconds.
Photos of the engine internals, fuel tank, and exhaust system.
Close-up of the serial number plate and proof of purchase if available.
response.reason: The generator is clearly identified as a FIRMAN ECO 8990ESR model from the photo. The seller's claims are supported by visible evidence. While there are hidden risks (mechanical condition, wear, authenticity), they are common to all used generators and do not prevent pricing. The item can be priced at its worst-case condition (not working, worn, unverified) based on the visible state.
